patterns.note: Sections are frequently separated by a subtle, organic wave-like divider, transitioning between solid background colors.
The hero section features a large, full-width blue background with a subtle grid pattern, containing text, CTA, and layered device mockups.
Primary headings use a large, bold serif font for impact, while body text and subheadings utilize a clean, highly legible sans-serif.
A vibrant, deep blue serves as the primary brand color, used for the hero background and call-to-action buttons, contrasting with clean white and dark grey content areas.
The hero section dynamically collapses in height as the user scrolls down, revealing the next content section while the navigation remains sticky at the top.
A prominent 'Drag, drop, set it apart' section showcases a diverse, scrollable grid of website design examples, emphasizing visual variety and ease of use.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a scroll-triggered animation (likely css-keyframes) to reduce its vertical height and scale its internal elements, creating a dynamic transition as the user scrolls down the page.
A sticky navigation bar is implemented, maintaining its position at the top of the viewport without changing its background or height, providing persistent access to navigation links.
Subtle parallax is applied to background elements within the hero section, making them scroll at a slightly different rate than foreground content, adding depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with clean, readable sans-serif body text, with smaller sans-serif labels and uppercase navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card corners (e.g., 4-8px), with some elements like the 'Get started' button having slightly more rounded corners. Images within mockups are often sharp.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy. The hero section is very airy, while feature grids maintain a balanced, consistent spacing between cards. Vertical rhythm is consistent with generous padding between main sections.

standout: The site distinguishes itself with its dynamic, collapsing hero section that smoothly transitions as the user scrolls, combined with unique wave-like section dividers. This creates a fluid and engaging visual experience that feels more interactive and less static than a generic marketing template.
